author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Disinflation and Fed Governor Waller's confidence that inflation is returning to 2 percent have pulled the 2Y down -16 bps in five observations, extended a bull flattening (10Y -54 bps over 20 observations) and pushed the dollar toward its worst month of 2023, lifting duration, gold producers, EM debt and crypto proxies. Equity indices have stalled after a near double-digit month with VIX at 12.69, so the stance is long duration and dollar-weakness beneficiaries, benchmark equity with cheap protection, underweight broad China beta and long Poland, where recovery data and EU funds outweigh caretaker-government and NBP noise.
sources_policy: Facts come only from the 2023-11-29 own-date frozen feed (cited [[nNNNN]] in the same paragraph) and the 2023-11-29 market card; no other dates, web resources or later knowledge. Previews are used only for pending events (China November PMI poll, OPEC+ meeting, Tesla Cybertruck event, Polish confidence vote) and never as outcomes. Spot-FX direction comes only from headlines, without numeric levels; DXY is quoted as an index.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n0716 Bloomberg 'Micron Falls Despite Raising Earnings Outlook, Beating Estimates' (dated 2023-11-28): no Micron results fall inside the 14-day window before this edition, so the record looks misdated or stale; not used.

n0108 Marvell 'Expected to Beat Earnings Estimates' preview: the company's report time relative to the cutoff cannot be established from own-date evidence and no result headline exists; not used as either pending or completed.
